changes.change: `pubkit site check DIR [--url URL]` checks a built public site for what robots and link previews need: each page's language, title, description and Open Graph card (WEB-PAGE-01/02, WEB-OG-01/03), an og:image LinkedIn accepts (WEB-OG-02), and a robots.txt that lets preview bots in (WEB-ROBOTS-01). Exceptions go in pubkit.json as for the Rust standard.

deploy-static runs `pubkit site check` on its directory before deploying and deploys nothing if it fails. Give the new `site-url` input so it can check og:image files, or set `check: false` for a site that is not public.

comment: Changes not yet released. One row per change: category changed or removed (a published interface changed: major), added (a feature: minor), or fixed or security (patch). `pubrel add` appends one; `pubrel summary` sets the release's summary; `pubrel prepare` moves them into the package publet.
